It adds no public command, wire field, semantic identity input, signature domain, role state or public error code. Existing operation owners must supply authorization for installation, first-write, explicit recovery, move, fork, adoption and retirement. Their absence is not permission to invent a CLI surface or initialize on an ordinary read.
